ezechiel: Ezechiel is a Hebrew prophet of the 6th century BC who was exiled to Babylon in 587 BC.
Ezechiel can also mean an Old Testament book containing Ezekiel's prophecies of the downfall of Jerusalem and Judah and their subsequent restoration.
Ezechiel means the same as Ezekiel or Book of Ezekiel.
ezed: An ezed is the 26th letter of the Roman alphabet.
For example: "The British call Z zed and the Scots call it ezed but Americans call it zee."
Ezed means the same as Z or z or zee.
ezekias: Ezekias is king of Judah who abolished idolatry.
Ezekias means the same as Hezekiah.

ezo: Ezo is the second largest of the four main islands of Japan.
Ezo means the same as Hokkaido or Yezo.
ezo-yama-hagi: Ezo-yama-hagi is Asian shrub having conspicuous racemose rose-purple flowers widely used as an ornamental and in erosion control and as a source of feed for wild birds.

ezra: Ezra is a Jewish priest and scribe sent by the Persian king to restore Jewish law and worship in Jerusalem.
Ezra can also mean an Old Testament book telling of a rabbi's efforts in the 5th century BC to reconstitute Jewish law and worship in Jerusalem after the Babylonian Captivity.
Ezra means the same as Book of Ezra.
ezra cornell: Ezra Cornell is United States businessman who unified the telegraph system in the United States and who in 1865 founded Cornell University.
Ezra Cornell means the same as Cornell.
ezra loomis pound: Ezra Loomis Pound is United States writer who lived in Europe.
